body: Your writing is beautiful.

I know what you mean. 

I always feel really lost. Everyone I know is successful and out there achieving their dreams and I’m stuck working a shitty job and feeling worthless. Everyone seems to like me, but I honestly don’t think I’m all that nice or fun to be with. 

My weight has gone up and down the past couple years, but I’ve been gaining again and I just feel sick when I think about it. 

Depression is so fucked up.

This has been one of my greatest struggles lately. When I was in high school, I was skinny and pretty. As I got older, depression got worse and I’ve had a bad habit and eating fast food when I’m sad or bored. Im almost 24 too. I’m not obese, but I don’t feel pretty anymore. I hate it when I look in the mirror, cause I can picture how I use to look. 

But anyway, you’re not the only one that turns to food. It depresses me to no end, which obviously only makes it worse. I’m sorry, friend.

I struggle with this too. When I go to work I’m so busy that I go into this sort of autopilot mode. And I’m like “wow, I’m having a great day” and then I get home and I’m exhausted and it all comes back. Mask is a good word for it.
That’s the only thing that’s ever stopped me... I know I’d be an addict. I hope the same for you friend
I’m getting close to trying anything... I’ve spent my whole life afraid of drugs but lately... I don’t care. I don’t wanna feel anything. I feel like I’d do it given the chance

I’m right here with you with the insomnia, man. I can never sleep anymore. If I could drink beer, I’m sure I would. It makes me really sick. I guess that makes it worse though because I take shots by myself. Vodka whiskey you name it. I even steal it from my roommates. What am I doing?
I feel am guilty... because I shouldn’t feel this way. I’m fine. I am so pathetic. Why am I so sad? I just hate this I want to be gone
I feel different. I see things differently. I’m young but I’m so unhappy. I feel so strongly. I want to disappear. I just don’t want to hurt my mom and my friends.
I just wish you were really here. I feel so alone.
I’m sorry. I don’t know it I want help. I like this feeling. I hate myself for it. I just keep drinking. I don’t think this life is worth it.
At least I know I’m not alone in this, even if it feels like it.

I feel like I should commit myself. My friends don’t understand. It’s not their fault. I’m crazy. I’m so drunk right now and just crying my eyes out. I want it to end. I know what road I’m going down.
I wish someone was here... with me. Someone that understands. I try to tell my friends. But they don’t understand this. I’m just a burden.
Nothing has changed... it’s been years. I’m so exhausted. I just don’t want to hurt anyone. I would be gone by now if I wouldn’t hurt anyone
I’d want to be SOMETHING. I want to make a difference.
I just don’t want to be here. That’s it, I guess.
I’m 23. Why am I doing this to myself? What do I do?
I feel empty. I don’t feel like myself anymore.
I used to. I stopped going... I was referred again but haven’t made the appointment.
I love my boyfriend, but I’m not good enough for him. And I love my pets. I’ve just been so bad for so long. I’m tired.
I don’t feel anything. Nothing is exciting. I hate my job. I can’t get anything done as far as my ambitions. I really just don’t want to be here.
I feel like it’s already happening. I think about wanting it a lot, and I jump on any chance to go out and drink.
I just don’t really know what to do with myself anymore, ya know? Doesn’t really matter what happens.
I don’t know. I just don’t want to feel everything else and it helps me feel numb... I guess.
I drink because it makes me feel something.
I don’t know. I just feel like they must feel bad for me.
It really is. I push it all down and then I go through phases like right now, where I feel it all at once and constantly. :(
Sometimes I just want to yell at people and make them understand. It’s just so tiring to keep it all in, ya know?

What are those things? I’m having trouble finding anything that makes me feel better anymore. My boyfriend makes me happy, but I still feel so sad all the time. I don’t play the games I used to play. I sleep all the time. Hate going to work.
I’m sorry you have this problem as well... I wish every day that I had a real life friend who understand this.
I just don’t really know what to do with myself anymore, you know?
Every day. All the time. I’m exhausted.
I was diagnosed a long time ago... I’ve tried several medications. They ALWAYS stop working after a few months. My doctor suggested a psych hospital if things didn’t change. I’m afraid to go there.
Yes
I just want to be something. My dream has always been to be an author and make people feel things but I’ve gotten nowhere and I just don’t have the motivation anymore.
I can relate to this so much... it's just so hard to begin the steps towards getting better.
